ITEM 1 | Two rectangular slices of flatbread-style crust side by side, the crust pale golden-tan with a slightly darker edge, sitting on a white square plate; a thin orange-red sauce layer is visible along the right edge of the crust, and the crust surface shows some puffy bubbles | 95
ITEM 2 | Melted white cheese layer covering the upper slice and the top part of the lower slice, glossy and slightly stretched in places, with dark brown blistered and charred spots scattered across it and a few thin pale strands hanging off the top edge; pale pinkish-tan chunks are visible under the cheese | 85
ITEM 3 | Thin orange-red tomato-based sauce band visible along the right side of the crust, matte and slightly moist, adjacent to the cheese edge and crust | 12
